modules.title: “自由职业者愿意付费使用催款提醒”怎样被最小成本验证
MVP 如何低成本验证核心假设并驱动决策

items.title: 只选一个高风险假设
items.text: 先找出一旦错误就会让方案失去价值的判断，例如目标用户是否愿意为自动催款付费，而不是同时验证所有功能。

items.title: 设计最小但可信的体验
items.text: 实验只保留验证该假设所需的价值、参与方式和反馈渠道；落地页、人工服务或小型可用版本都可能合适，取决于要学什么。

items.title: 事先约定证据和下一步
items.text: 明确观察谁的什么行为、达到什么信号后继续，以及证据不足或假设不成立时怎样调整或停止。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: MVP 不是低质量的残缺产品。“可行”表示目标用户能真实体验要验证的核心价值，并产生足以支持下一步决策的证据；安全、隐私、基本可信度和实验所需的关键体验不能因为追求“最小”而被省掉。

lessonPractice.title: 团队最担心“自由职业者是否愿意付费使用自动催款”。哪种 MVP 最能先验证这个风险？

options.label: 向目标用户售卖小规模试点，先人工完成催款，并记录购买、使用和续费
options.feedback: 对。真实付款直接检验付费意愿，人工交付则让团队不用先建设完整自动化系统；购买、使用和续费行为还能帮助判断价值是否持续。

options.label: 快速上线一套功能残缺、数据保护也未完成的财务系统，再看用户会不会抱怨
options.feedback: 低质量和安全缺口会污染反馈并伤害用户，无法说明核心价值是否成立；“最小”不能省掉可信实验必需的条件。

options.label: 发布一张免费功能概念图，只统计点赞数，并据此判断用户愿意付费
options.feedback: 点赞表达的兴趣与真实付费行为不同。这种证据没有直接检验当前最关键的付费假设。

en.title: The team’s biggest risk is whether freelancers will pay for automatic payment reminders. Which MVP tests that risk first?

options.label: Sell a small paid pilot, deliver reminders manually, and track purchase, usage, and renewal
options.feedback: Correct. An actual payment directly tests willingness to pay, while manual delivery avoids building the full automation system first. Purchase, usage, and renewal behavior also show whether the value lasts.

options.label: Quickly launch an incomplete finance suite without finished data protection, then watch whether users complain
options.feedback: Poor quality and safety gaps distort feedback and harm users. Being minimal does not remove conditions required for a trustworthy experiment.

options.label: Post a free feature concept image, count likes, and treat that as proof that users will pay
options.feedback: Likes show a different kind of interest from actual payment behavior, so this evidence does not directly test the key willingness-to-pay assumption.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 我们最担心的是自由职业者愿不愿意为自动催款付费。请设计一个只验证这件事的付费小规模试点，写清价格、退款规则、找哪些人、人工怎样交付、记录哪些购买和续费证据，以及什么结果意味着继续或停止。联系用户或收款前先让我确认；免费试用、问卷表态或点赞只能说明兴趣，不能当作付费证据。保留隐私和基本可信度，不要扩成完整财务产品。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Our biggest risk is whether freelancers will pay for automatic payment reminders. Design a small paid pilot that tests only that question: specify the price, refund policy, target participants, manual delivery, purchase and renewal evidence, and the result that means continue or stop. Ask for my confirmation before contacting anyone or collecting payment. Free trials, survey claims, or likes can show interest but do not count as payment evidence. Keep privacy and basic trust intact, and do not expand this into a full finance product.

references.title: 什么是最小可行产品（MVP）？
references.title_en: What is a Minimum Viable Product (MVP)?

learning.assumes: You have seen teams cut features to ship sooner or build before testing an idea.
learning.outcome: You can choose a small experiment that produces valid evidence for a risky assumption and spot an unreliable product mislabeled as an MVP.

modules.title: Test willingness to pay before building the automation
How an MVP turns effort into useful learning

items.title: Choose one risky assumption
items.text: Start with the claim that would make the idea fail if it is wrong, such as whether the target user will pay.

items.title: Build a minimal credible experience
items.text: Keep only the value, participation, and feedback needed to test that claim. A landing page, manual service, or small working version can fit.

items.title: Set the evidence and next move
items.text: Decide what behavior to observe and what result means continue, change direction, or stop.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: An MVP is not a low-quality product. It must still provide the core value credibly enough to produce evidence, including the safety, privacy, and trust the experiment requires.
